purpose: Counterfactual signal audit from numeric maps through frozen-LM behavior

summary_findings.diagnosis: The current-checkpoint measurements do not support the historical global Perceiver-collapse diagnosis: native-latent/block-token relative-L2 retention ranges from 0.508794 to 0.908363, and native-latent mean off-diagonal cosine ranges from 0.932192 to 0.946903. Behavioral usefulness must be established by normalized exact generation and held-out controls, not by prefix hashes or nonzero tensor differences.
summary_findings.diagnosis_basis: Computed from this checkpoint's reported pair metrics. Thresholds are <=0.1 native-latent/block-token relative-L2 retention for severe attenuation and >=0.99 mean off-diagonal cosine for near-duplicate native latents.
summary_findings.recommended_fix: Do not infer a resampler defect from this structural audit alone. Use the exact generation scores and held-out counterfactual controls to localize the next failure before changing the encoder.
